headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of October 20, 2026, the portfolio has achieved an average return of 25.29%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.56%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolio is not only growing in absolute terms but is also generating an average alpha of 11.73%. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 36.36%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned only 1.47%, highlighting a disparity in performance among the portfolios. The ability to outperform SPY during this period suggests resilience amidst broader market conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
